name: singlet_feature_selection_highly_variable_gene_selection
title: Select highly variable genes
description: Selects the top N highly variable genes of one single-cell dataset for PCA, neighbour graphs and clustering, scoring each gene against a technical null chosen by flavor (default pearson_residuals, the variance of analytic Pearson residuals of raw counts). Reads raw counts for count flavors, or a log-normalised layer for seurat, cell_ranger and scran_model_gene_var, and writes var/highly_variable, var/hvg_score, var/hvg_rank, var/means, var/variances and uns/hvg. Do not use it to choose genes with cell-type labels, to pick genes shared across batches for integration (use the batch-aware selection task), or to decide how many genes to keep (use the number-of-features task).

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

layer.description: Layer to score. Null selects layers/counts for count flavors and layers/log1p_norm for log flavors; fails if absent or in the wrong state.

flavor.description: Selection statistic. Count input: pearson_residuals (default), binomial_deviance, seurat_v3. Log-normalised input: seurat, cell_ranger, scran_model_gene_var.

n_top_genes.description: Number of genes to keep (N). Always returns N genes; cutoff-based selection is not offered.

batch_key.description: obs column with batch labels. Null treats the dataset as one batch; otherwise statistics are computed per batch and combined by a flavor-specific rule.

seurat_v3.description: Options for flavor seurat_v3; ignored by other flavors.

span.description: Loess span of the variance trend.

clip.description: Fitted standard deviations above the mean at which counts are clipped. Null uses sqrt(n_cells) per batch.

pearson_residuals.description: Options for flavor pearson_residuals; ignored by other flavors.

theta.description: Shared negative-binomial size parameter of the residual model.

clip.description: Absolute bound on residuals. Null uses sqrt(n_cells) per batch.

binomial_deviance.description: Options for flavor binomial_deviance; ignored by other flavors.

family.description: Approximating family of the multinomial deviance; poisson may be faster and is often very similar.

seurat.description: Options for flavor seurat; ignored by other flavors.

n_bins.description: Number of equal-width mean bins for dispersion normalisation.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without writing any member.

overwrite.description: Replace existing highly-variable-gene members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. var/highly_variable. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs: flavor, layer, n_genes_selected, n_batches, score_at_N, top_genes (first 20 symbols) and warnings. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
